issues.legal_issue: A government’s confirmation on appeal of a collector’s refusal to reassess converted land does not constitute a direction displacing the collector’s mandatory reassessment duty unless the government clearly and unambiguously issues and duly notifies such a direction.
material_facts: Agricultural land was converted to non-agricultural use, and the landholder requested reassessment.
The collector refused the request when no government direction to the contrary had been issued.
The government later confirmed the collector’s refusal on appeal, but it had adopted no resolution or issued no notified direction under the applicable rule.
issues.conclusion: The government’s confirmation of the collector’s refusal was not a direction to act otherwise under Rule 92.
issues.legal_principle: Rule 92 under the Bombay Land Revenue Code, 1879, imposed an imperative duty on the Collector to alter the assessment when land assessed for agriculture was used for a non-agricultural purpose, unless the Government directed otherwise. Because such a direction affects civil rights, it must be expressed in clear and unambiguous terms and notified in the usual manner. Mere confirmation on appeal of the Collector’s refusal is not such a direction. The Court relied on Sections 48(2) and 214 and Rules 81 to 87 and 92; it cited no earlier cases for this principle.

rule.if: appeal_from_assessment_refusal and governing_rule_imposes_mandatory_reassessment and government_only_affirmed_collector_refusal and not clear_notified_government_direction

predicates.appeal_from_assessment_refusal: A landholder brought an appeal challenging the refusal to reassess land.
predicates.governing_rule_imposes_mandatory_reasses: The applicable rule requires the revenue authority to reassess land when it is put to a different use, unless the government directs otherwise.
predicates.government_only_affirmed_collector_refus: The government merely affirmed the collector’s refusal to reassess the land.
predicates.clear_notified_government_direction: The government issued a clear direction to the revenue authority and notified it in the usual manner.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges refusal of reassessment under a rule requiring reassessment, a government affirmation alone does not count as a direction to the contrary if no clear, notified direction was issued.

issues.legal_issue: A landholder is entitled to reassessment of agricultural land converted to non-agricultural use when the governing rule makes reassessment mandatory and the government has issued no direction to the contrary.
material_facts: Land assessed for agricultural use was converted to non-agricultural use.
The landholder requested altered assessment, but the Collector refused.
No government direction displacing the reassessment duty had been issued.
The claim concerned converted lands for which the High Court had denied the requested assessment relief.
issues.conclusion: The landholder was entitled to have the assessment altered on the converted lands, and the State was directed to assess and levy the altered assessment and pay it to the landholder.
issues.legal_principle: Section 48(2) of the Bombay Land Revenue Code, 1879, provides for alteration of assessment when land is used for a purpose different from that for which it was assessed. Rule 92, read with Rules 81 to 87, directs the Collector in imperative terms to alter the assessment when land assessed for agriculture is used for a purpose unconnected with agriculture, unless the Government directs otherwise. The Court held that the Collector had no option where no contrary government direction existed. It cited no earlier cases for this principle.

rule.if: appeal_from_denial_of_reassessment and agricultural_land_used_for_nonagricultural_purpose and landholder_requested_reassessment and not clear_notified_government_direction

predicates.appeal_from_denial_of_reassessment: A landholder appealed the denial of a request to reassess land.
predicates.agricultural_land_used_for_nonagricultur: Land assessed for agricultural use was put to a purpose unconnected with agriculture.
predicates.landholder_requested_reassessment: The landholder asked the revenue authority to alter the assessment after the land’s use changed.
predicates.clear_notified_government_direction: The government issued a clear direction to the revenue authority and notified it in the usual manner.

issues.definition: When a landholder appeals denial of reassessment for land converted from agricultural to non-agricultural use, reassessment must be made and levied if the government has issued no clear, notified direction to the contrary.
